messages:
Alice Nguyen: FYI customer (Uproot) is blocked on their Dedicated POC — trying to provision a GPU pool in eu-west3 but hitting reservation/affinity errors. They need guidance + pricing clarity for a 3-month reserved workload.
Raj Patel: can you paste the exact error they see? also which quota/region did they pick? :eyes: 
Alice Nguyen: error from our UI/API: 

```
POST /v1/dedicated/pools
403 ReservationConflict: reservation already exists for project:upr-analytics region:eu-west3
X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d
```

They also reported a 429 when retrying multiple times: `rate_limit_exceeded` from provisioning API.
Kim Rivera: customer also asked whether AZ-affinity is required for their compliance profile — security questionnaire flagged AZ pinning as a question. They'd prefer single-AZ for now if that speeds things up.
Raj Patel: OK couple of things: 1) 403 ReservationConflict usually means there is an existing reservation object (maybe from an earlier test) tied to their project/commit. 2) 429 suggests our async reservation creation is being retried by the UI/CLI quickly — might need backoff or manual cleanup.
Raj Patel: Ask them to run the cleanup check (CLI snippet):

```
# check reservations
ri-cli reservations list --project upr-analytics --region eu-west3
# if orphaned reservation id=abc123
ri-cli reservations delete --id abc123
```

Alice Nguyen: I pushed that to them and they pasted logs showing a stale reservation id that belongs to a different team in their org. They don't have perms to delete it.
Sophie (eng-platform): tagging infra-bot to check cluster-level state and whether the reservation is orphaned / stuck. @infra-bot any insights?
infra-bot: Received incident request r-1945678901. Triggering reservation audit in eu-west3...
infra-bot: Audit result: 1 orphaned reservation (id abc123) created 2025-07-02T09:12:34Z by service-account:prow-ops@upr. Reservation is attached to project upr-legacy, conflicting with upr-analytics namespace.
Kim Rivera: customer cannot get legacy team to act quickly. They asked if we can short-circuit by creating a new pool in a nearby region (eu-west4) or disable AZ-affinity to avoid the conflict. Also wants a firm price for reserved 2xA100 per month for 3 months.
Raj Patel: short term workaround: create pool in eu-west4 (same latency envelope) or create pool in eu-west3 but set `az_affinity: none` in the reservation request. Note: disabling AZ-affinity may affect their compliance posture — flag that to PM/SP.
Raj Patel: Pricing: committed reserved price is negotiated; base SKU pricing is $X per-GPU-hour + commitment discount. For a 3-month short-term reserved quote, I'll draft an inline estimate and send to Sales Ops.
Alice Nguyen: they asked whether switching region requires a new reservation id or multiplies their billing. Clarify please.
Sophie (eng-platform): region change = new reservation resource -> new billing reservation. We can migrate workloads but reservations don't transfer automatically. If they want a human-assisted path, we can create the pool in eu-west4 under a temporary reservation and later re-provision.
Raj Patel: Next steps I recommend: 1) eng-platform deletes orphaned reservation (abc123) or tags it for transfer, 2) if not possible within 24h, create eu-west4 pool for POC, 3) Sales provide provisional 3-month reserved quote and note billing implications.
Alice Nguyen: I've told the customer we'll try to get the orphan deleted by EOD; if not, we spin up eu-west4. Also asked them to confirm whether single-AZ (no az_affinity) is acceptable for their POC.
Kim Rivera: I'll escalate the security questionnaire item: single-AZ for POC is acceptable under their contract addendum. They confirmed.
Sophie (eng-platform): tagging @Sophie — I'm on it, will request reservation deletion today and post the ticket number. If we hit permission issues, I'll coordinate with infra-ops to perform a forced delete.
infra-bot: Reservation delete request submitted: job j-7782. Estimated completion 30 minutes.
Alice Nguyen: thanks. Also customer asked about API throttling — any quick mitigation?
Raj Patel: add exponential backoff in client, and we can temporarily raise their provisioning quota for the org while POC runs. I'll open a support quota bump.
Alice Nguyen: perfect. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
Sophie (eng-platform): update — job j-7782 succeeded, orphan reservation abc123 removed at 2025-07-03T15:42:10Z. Customer retried provisioning and got success.
Alice Nguyen: closing loop with customer now. They want formal note on billing impact and the 3-month quote before signing.
Kim Rivera: sales ops, I'll hand off to you for the quote and finalize contract addendum re: single-AZ POC.
Raj Patel: will follow up with a short doc on recommended config (no az_affinity for POC), CLI cleanup steps, and a small snippet for exponential backoff in their deployer.
Alice Nguyen: thanks team — great swarm! :tada:
